comments.body: Done in 19f9afd7: muster window --json's asking[] entries carry callsign, label and subtitle (null when empty); docs/cli/window.md now describes asking[].
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Since 8076015d the core's AskingEntry carries each pane's callsign and label, and the Needs you strip titles cards from them, including another window's agents. `muster window --json`'s `asking` entries still list only `pane` and `group`, so an agent reading who is asking has to cross-reference panes, and for another window's pane it must look under other_windows.
title: muster window --json's asking entries do not carry the callsign and label the strip shows
